describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, standing on all four limbs with its body arched. It is a stout, quadrupedal mammal with an elongated tapering snout, a long thick tail resting on the ground behind it, and a body mostly covered in overlapping dark brown to gray-brown keratinous scales. Large irregular patches of pale pink, wrinkled, bare skin interrupt the scaly covering on the mid-back, the mid-flank, and the lower rear flank. The underbelly and inner portions of the limbs are pale beige skin with sparse scaling. The head is narrow with a small dark eye and a rounded ear, the limbs are short and muscular ending in large curved claws with dark soil around the feet, and the tail is long, tapering, and scaly.

describe.description: A bulky quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile with an arched back, a long pointed snout, and a long tapered tail curled forward under its body. Most of its back, sides, top of the head, outer legs and tail are covered in overlapping dark brown-gray keratin scales, but there are large irregular pale pink bare fleshy patches on the back and flank where scales are absent, and the underside and parts of the legs are pale gray-pink wrinkled skin. It stands on four short sturdy legs ending in long dark curved digging claws, with its head held low.
